Manage virtual machine instances

Usage:
  yc compute instance <command> [flags...] [args...]

Commands:
  create                       Create a virtual machine
  delete                       Delete a virtual machine
  get                          Show information about a virtual machine
  list                         List virtual machines

Flags:
      --folder-id string
          Folder ID
      --folder-name string
          Folder name
      --async

Global Flags:
      --profile string
          Set the custom configuration file
      --debug
          Debug logging
